description: Economic Impacts of Low Carbon Growth Scenarios in Selected Developing Countries (Thailand Case Study) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate", published or maintained by World Bank Group. The role of developing countries is very important in dealing with global climate change because even the full elimination of developed country emissions would not avoid global warming. Coverage: Thailand. It has 1 file in XLS. The portal files it under Climate. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
